description: This script sets up a Git repository with a specific branch and merge history to test 'git blame' functionality with topic branches. It defines test cases for verifying blame annotations across different commits and merges.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with optional file modifications, used for setting up the repository state.

methods.name: test_merge
methods.description: Performs a merge between branches in the test repository setup.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed with given commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
